_comment: String table for the onboarding/demo slider (js/onboarding-slider.js). Separate from the main i18n/en.json on purpose — the slider is a standalone feature with its own key namespace (onboard_*) so it can ship, iterate, and gain translations independently of the ~1174-key main table. This file mirrors the ONBOARD_STRINGS_EN inline fallback kept in js/onboarding-slider.js itself (same emergency-fallback pattern as SR_STRINGS_EN in js/render-i18n.js — see that file's header comment). Only English exists today; add sibling hi.json/ta.json/etc. here with exact key parity when translation work starts, same as the main i18n/ folder.
onboard_lang_footnote: You can change this anytime from the language menu. This welcome tour itself is available in English only for now; other languages are coming soon.
onboard_s1_headline:
Every institution collects marks.
Almost none turn them into insight.
onboard_s1_problem_1: Hours lost in Excel every exam cycle — averages, ranks, pass/fail lists computed by hand.
onboard_s1_problem_2: Still can't easily answer: which students actually need help, and why?
onboard_s1_sub: A free, privacy-first analytics tool for schools, colleges & coaching centers.
onboard_s1_what_1: Upload one Excel marksheet → full dashboard in seconds
onboard_s1_what_2: Runs entirely in your browser — no login, no server, no upload
onboard_s1_what_3: Auto-generates dashboards, narrative report cards, risk flags & PDF exports
onboard_s1_what_4: The Excel file IS the save file — nothing about a student ever leaves the device
onboard_s2_flaw: One shared flaw: analytics is buried inside a bloated, whole-institution suite that needs an annual budget and 4–8 weeks of IT setup.
onboard_s2_headline: You already pay for — or are sold — a School ERP.
onboard_s2_r4_drawback: Pay yearly whether used or not
onboard_s2_sub: Here's what that market looks like, and where it falls short.
onboard_s3_note: Only 57% of schools report functional computers; just 63.5% report internet access — most need a tool that works with just an Excel file, not a heavy cloud ERP.
onboard_s3_source: Sources: UDISE+ 2024-25 (Ministry of Education, GoI) · AISHE 2021-22 (Ministry of Education, GoI) · IMARC Group India Coaching Institutes Market 2025
onboard_s3_sub: It's nearly every school, college, and coaching center in India.
onboard_s4_headline: We know the ERP is big.
onboard_s4_note: Already have an ERP? StudIn is a free, zero-risk add-on for the one job it may do poorly. Don't have one? Get 80% of the value without the cost.
onboard_s4_sub: StudIn doesn't try to be the whole system — it does one part of it, better.
onboard_s5_closing: 0 cost · 0 setup · 0 data leaves your school
onboard_s5_cta: Try it today — no signup, no IT ticket. Start with one class as a pilot.
